assessments.rationale: Read all three issues: #36 creates the base, #37 migrates onto it, #34 removes a duplicate that the same base would absorb. One outcome.
#37's body names EventConsumerBase as the target type, and no such type exists in src/ today.
The issue does lack acceptance criteria, but it does name the four helpers, so 'files' overstates what is missing.
No open issue mentions Azure, Container Apps, or Step 12c; ImplementationPlan.md lists it as the next step.
AlarmStore and BillingStore still each define their own duck_progress load/mark; no shared helper exists. The issue is live.
